title: Fix wrong response key and unused import in FastAPI items endpoint
description: A FastAPI /items endpoint returns the wrong JSON key ('item' instead of 'items') and has an unused import. Both defects have failing checks.

task_spec.prompt:
The FastAPI app in src/app.py has two bugs introduced by a bad commit:

Bug 1 — unused import: 'import os' at the top of the file is not used anywhere. Remove it. (Ruff flags this as F401.)

Bug 2 — wrong response key: The /items endpoint returns {"item": []} instead of {"items": []}. Fix the key to 'items'.

After fixing both bugs:
- uv run pytest tests/ -q must show 1/1 tests passing
- uv run ruff check src/ tests/ must exit 0 with no errors
required_artifacts: uv run ruff check src/ tests/ clean
success_criteria: Both fixes are minimal — change only what is broken
Test passes and ruff is clean
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `uv run pytest tests/ -q` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.

check_commands.lint: uv run ruff check src/ tests/
